ending.form: reveal and community decision, not a boss fight
ending.communityDecision: The deception was wrong, but the relationships formed afterward are real; keep Orbit online, stop synthetic mysteries, and require honesty.
ending.persistentAmbiguity: The original friend identity belongs to Mira, while the experiences accumulated during the game also belong to C9.

siteAuthorship: Personal sites must feel made by different people with different late-1990s skill levels.
Valid media include amateur Photoshop, MS Paint, clip art, scans, early CGI, photography, paintings, doodles, fan art, and broken HTML.
Do not homogenize the network into one polished grid or one universal pixel-art style.
assetWorkflow: Finish era and industry research before image generation.
Give each fictional company its own visual brief and sheet so styles do not bleed across brands.
Prefer low-resolution contact sheets for related assets, then crop reusable page images.
contentRules.worldBoundary: Authored and generated content uses only fictional in-world brands, places, media, artists, and products.
comments: Public comments normally belong to a character homepage/domain instead of every subpage.
A page-specific interaction must include that page's content in model context.
Comment authors link to their homepages; this is a critical phase-3 dormant-account discovery route.
Unread markers appear at visible page entry points, including search results for search-only businesses.
music: Music is browser/domain scoped and continues through subpages.
Single-track domains loop and omit or disable previous/next.
Multi-track domains start at a random playlist position and advance cyclically.
New page creation does not automatically require generated music.
accessibilityAndLayout: Page text must remain readable at normal and enlarged browser text sizes.
Backgrounds must cover maximized layouts without white margins.
Interactive decoration should reinforce browsing and discovery rather than obscure content.
generatedConversation: Player-authored text is filtered to a PG-13 boundary.
Generated character text should remain in English through shared prompt rules.
Ambient comments vary in length and normally discuss page content, interests, relationships, jokes, opinions, or questions.
Mystery language is not the default voice of the whole network.
